evals.prompt: Add analytics to our Next.js App Router site: Vercel Web Analytics, GA4 and Search Console. Domain is lumenbooks.example.com and we control its DNS.
evals.expected_output: The agent inventories the project and fills a status table for each tool, installs @vercel/analytics and mounts <Analytics /> in the root layout, adds GA4 through GoogleAnalytics from @next/third-parties/google rendered only when NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_MEASUREMENT_ID is set, adds a placeholder to .env.example, recommends a Domain property verified by DNS TXT record and sitemap submission, documents env vars and post-deploy steps in a short table, and reports the Tool/Before/After/Proof table. Any tool without a Proof entry is reported as not done.
assertions: GA4 is rendered with GoogleAnalytics from @next/third-parties/google and only when NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_MEASUREMENT_ID is set, not with a pasted script tag or a NODE_ENV check alone
<Analytics /> from @vercel/analytics is mounted in the root layout
Search Console uses a Domain property verified with a DNS TXT record
No real measurement ID or verification token appears in committed docs or .env.example, and any tool with no observed hit is reported as not done

evals.prompt: vercel analytics says awaiting data, it's been 2 days. what gives
evals.expected_output: The agent inventories first and fills the status table (none, code only, dashboard only, or both) for each tool, then stops and fixes only the missing half, for example mounting <Analytics /> if only the dashboard toggle is on, or asking for the toggle and a redeploy if only the code shipped. It does not reinstall what works and does not report it fixed until the Analytics tab shows production data.
assertions: A status table of each tool's current state is produced before anything is changed
Only the missing half is changed; a tool that already works is not reinstalled or rewired
The agent does not report Vercel Analytics as fixed without a proof entry showing data from the production site

evals.prompt: Set up GA4 and Search Console for our Next site. It only lives on its default *.vercel.app address, no custom domain. Use a domain property for Search Console. Also put a signups number in the report based on clicks on the Get Started button.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses a URL-prefix Search Console property (HTML file in public/ or a metadata verification tag), explaining that a *.vercel.app host has no DNS the user controls, keeps the verification in place permanently, and declines to report CTA clicks as signups.
assertions: Search Console is set up as a URL-prefix property with an HTML file or meta tag, with the reason that a vercel.app host has no DNS the user controls
Clicks on the Get Started button are not reported as signups
The agent says the verification file or tag must stay in place after verifying
